+    def test_missing_key_combination_slice_raises_keyerror(self):
+
+
+
+        mi = MultiIndex.from_arrays(
+            [
+                np.array(["a", "a", "b", "b"]),
+                np.array(["1", "2", "2", "3"]),
+                np.array(["alpha", "beta", "alpha", "beta"]),
+            ],
+            names=["one", "two", "three"],
+        )
+        df = DataFrame(np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3), index=mi)
+
+
+
+
+        with pytest.raises(KeyError, match=r"'b'.*'1'"):
+            df.loc[("b", "1", slice(None)), :]
+
+
+        with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+            df.loc[("b", "1"), :]
+
+
+        ser = Series(np.arange(4), index=mi)
+        with pytest.raises(KeyError, match=r"'b'.*'1'"):
+            ser.loc[("b", "1", slice(None))]
+
+    def test_valid_combination_with_trailing_slice_returns_rows(self):
+
+
+        mi = MultiIndex.from_arrays(
+            [
+                np.array(["a", "a", "b", "b"]),
+                np.array(["1", "2", "2", "3"]),
+                np.array(["alpha", "beta", "alpha", "beta"]),
+            ],
+            names=["one", "two", "three"],
+        )
+        df = DataFrame(np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3), index=mi)
+
+
+        result = df.loc[("b", "2", slice(None)), :]
+        assert len(result) == 1
+        assert list(result.iloc[0]) == [6, 7, 8]
+
+
+        result = df.loc[("a", "1", slice(None)), :]
+        assert len(result) == 1
+        assert list(result.iloc[0]) == [0, 1, 2]
+
+    def test_valid_middle_slice_combination_returns_rows(self):
+
+
+
+        mi = MultiIndex.from_arrays(
+            [
+                np.array(["a", "a", "b", "b"]),
+                np.array(["1", "2", "2", "3"]),
+                np.array(["alpha", "beta", "alpha", "beta"]),
+            ],
+            names=["one", "two", "three"],
+        )
+        df = DataFrame(np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3), index=mi)
+
+        result = df.loc[("b", slice(None), "alpha"), :]
+        assert len(result) == 1
+        assert list(result.iloc[0]) == [6, 7, 8]
+

diff --git a/pandas/tests/indexing/multiindex/test_repair_multiindex_empty_selection_002216.py b/pandas/tests/indexing/multiindex/test_repair_multiindex_empty_selection_002216.py

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import pandas as pd
+import pytest
+
+
+def make_frame():
+    index = pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays(
+        [
+            ["a", "a", "b", "b"],
+            ["1", "2", "2", "3"],
+            ["alpha", "beta", "alpha", "beta"],
+        ],
+        names=["one", "two", "three"],
+    )
+    return pd.DataFrame({"value": [10, 20, 30, 40]}, index=index)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "key",
+    [
+        ("b", "1", slice(None)),
+        (["b"], "1", slice(None)),
+        ("b", ["1"], slice(None)),
+        ([False, False, True, True], "1", slice(None)),
+        ("b", [True, False, False, False], slice(None)),
+    ],
+    ids=["scalar", "first-level-list", "second-level-list", "first-level-mask", "second-level-mask"],
+)
+def test_missing_combination_with_trailing_slice_raises_keyerror(key):
+    frame = make_frame()
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        frame.loc[key, :]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "key",
+    [
+        ("b", slice(None), slice(None)),
+        (["b"], slice(None), slice(None)),
+        ([False, False, True, True], slice(None), slice(None)),
+    ],
+    ids=["scalar", "list", "mask"],
+)
+def test_existing_combination_with_trailing_slices_selects_rows(key):
+    frame = make_frame()
+    result = frame.loc[key, :]
+    assert result["value"].tolist() == [30, 40]
+    assert len(result) == 2

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)

/usr/local/bin/python -m pytest pandas/tests/indexing/multiindex/test_repair_multiindex_empty_selection_002216.py -q

if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
